title: Users
purpose: Find staff accounts and review their assigned access.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: The administration site requires an active account with Staff status. User and group pages additionally require Superuser status; an admin role alone or individual model permissions do not open them. These technical flags do not themselves confer operational roles or disposal approval authority.

items.label: Username
items.description: Sign-in identifier and link to the user change form; sortable.

items.label: Name
items.description: Full first/last name or dash. Sorts by last name, not the displayed combined string.

items.label: Email address
items.description: Account authentication/recovery email, sortable; used for sign-in and recovery.

items.label: Roles
items.description: Assigned group names alphabetically, including custom groups, or None with no group. It is not an expanded list of admin’s effective operational roles and is not sortable.

items.label: Can approve disposal
items.description: Boolean for active accounts holding accounts approve_disposal directly or through a group. Not sortable.

items.label: Active / Superuser status
items.description: Enabled-account and technical superuser flags, both sortable. Staff status is not a column on this list.

items.label: Last login
items.description: Latest successful login time, or dash; sortable.

sections.title: Search, filters and paging
paragraphs: Search matches case-insensitive substrings. Space-separated terms must each match at least one configured field; quote a phrase to match it as one term. The result query includes all matches, not just visible rows. Clearing the search restores the unsearched set while preserving applicable filters.

These are Django administration tables, not operational grids. The server uses 100 records per page, with numbered page links and a total count. Show all appears when the filtered result count is at most 200 and exceeds one page. There is no Rows per page selector or Columns dialog. Linked sortable headings change order; repeated heading clicks change direction or remove that ordering. The sidebar navigation filter only filters module links, not table records.
Initial order is Username ascending. No row-selection checkboxes or bulk actions are shown because account actions are disabled.

items.label: Search
items.description: Username, first name, last name or email.

items.label: disposal approval
items.description: Can approve disposal selects active users with the actual accounts approve_disposal permission; Cannot approve disposal includes everyone else.

items.label: active / superuser status / groups
items.description: Standard boolean and group filters. Groups includes custom groups. All removes an individual restriction. Sidebar filters use links, with All restoring that filter. Show counts or Hide counts toggles per-option counts, and Clear all filters clears active sidebar restrictions. Filtering applies to all records and resets paging.

items.label: Add user
items.description: Opens account creation. No invitation is sent automatically. Existing users are deactivated rather than deleted.

sections.title: Role, preservation and edit rules
paragraphs: The admin group implies the manager, technician and viewer roles; disposal approval is not implied and needs explicit accounts approve_disposal. Nobody approves their own disposal request. User deletion is disabled. Forms prevent demoting/deactivating the last active superuser. User/group and administrator password changes have attributed audit events without password values.
